title: Archive test cannot contact the document service
root_cause: The test uses the service container hostname from a job running on the runner host, where that hostname does not resolve. It needs to connect to localhost on the published port 27123, and unittest reports the resulting connection error.

relevant_evidence.why: The test traceback shows a hostname resolution failure.
The database is published on host port 27123.
The test attempts to use the service container hostname.
